name: QA Engineer Pack
description: Workflows for QA engineers and quality-focused developers: contract testing, load testing, browser testing, security validation, and building robust automated test suites.
useCases: Build automated test suites spanning unit, contract, and browser tests.
Design and run load tests to validate performance before a release.
Reproduce, isolate, and verify fixes for reported bugs, including security-relevant input handling.
examplePrompts: Write contract tests for this REST API so consumer and provider cannot drift apart.
Design a load-test plan for this endpoint ahead of launch, including realistic traffic shapes and pass/fail criteria.
